C-16.Name: Agent-output paste hygiene: smart paste + clipboard image paste (matrix P0-C/P0-D)
C-16.IntentSummary: Make pasting agent-grade content first-class: URLs (incl. bare hosts) over a selection become markdown links with escaped labels, rich HTML keeps converting through the existing sanitized html2State path (adversarially pinned), and the existing clipboard-bitmap pipeline is pinned and smoke-verified in WKWebView — with the Rust NSPasteboard reader deferred unless that smoke fails, and no regression to the three existing paste behaviors.

T-001.Title: W1: muya pasteCtrl URL smart-paste branch (R-1)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Clipboard bare http(s)/mailto URL + non-empty selection → [selected text](url), cursor after the link; empty selection keeps plain-URL paste. Table-driven unit tests for both branches and the not-a-URL guard (e.g. "see https://…" mid-text stays plain).

text/html clipboard payload → DOMPurify sanitize → existing html2State path is pinned (adversarial sanitization fixtures: script/style/on* never survive (adversarial fixtures); markdown/code selection paste behavior unchanged.

T-003.Title: W2: pin existing HTML + bitmap paste paths (R-2, R-3)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Adversarial sanitization fixtures (script/style/on* attributes) against standardizeHTML; rich-HTML fixtures through html2State; pasteImage items-branch unit test (synthetic File → image block via imageAction stub). Rust NSPasteboard reader deferred (non-goal) pending WKWebView smoke evidence.
V-M-012 scenario-15 (URL/HTML/image paste pins) + command wiring; pasteCtrl.js MODULE_CONTRACT added (previously ungoverned); markers follow the [Module][fn][BLOCK_*] convention.

T-006.Title: W3: e2e visual gate (HTML paste) + WKWebView smoke checklist

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Playwright spec (tests/e2e/smart-paste.spec.ts): rich HTML → markdown equivalent renders; hostile HTML yields no live script/handler markup. URL-over-selection and clipboard image are pinned in tests/renderer/muya/paste-smart.test.js (muya's cursor model cannot be committed by synthetic Chromium events) and added to the live-app WKWebView smoke checklist: real Cmd+V of a URL over a selection → [text](url); real screenshot paste → local image file + relative link.

npm test green; scoped 100% coverage on the changed pasteCtrl branch; CI-mode coverage thresholds green; review-1 (correctness/races — clipboard read timing, guard ordering) and review-2 (security/contracts — URL/label markdown injection, sanitization adversarial cases) both CLEAN.

Verification.Command: npm run test:coverage; review verdicts in Evidence.

Review-1.Angle: correctness, races (clipboard read vs typing, async image write), edge cases

Review-2.Angle: security (untrusted HTML sanitization, image filename/path handling), GRACE contract consistency, regression risk to existing paste paths
Review-2.PassCriteria: zero findings; sanitization adversarial cases pinned
